title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 8: the tablet for Maher Shalal Hash Baz, the flood of Assyria, and Yahweh as sanctuary and stumbling stone.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say to write on a large tablet with a man's pen?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man's pen, 'For Maher Shalal Hash Baz.'"

questions.text: Who were the faithful witnesses Yahweh took to testify?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah."

answers.text: The prophetess and her two sons
The elders and the rulers of Jerusalem
Rezin the king and the son of Remaliah
Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah

questions.text: Who conceived and bore the son who was named Maher Shalal Hash Baz?
questions.explanation: The speaker says, "I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son," and Yahweh told him to name the boy Maher Shalal Hash Baz.

questions.text: What will the king of Assyria carry away before the child knows how to say "My father" and "My mother"?
questions.explanation: Before the child can say "My father" and "My mother", the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.

answers.text: The treasures of Yahweh's temple in Jerusalem
The flocks and the herds of the land of Judah
The riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria
The gold and silver of the king's house

questions.text: Which waters has this people refused, according to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son."

answers.text: The waters of the upper pool

questions.text: Who do the mighty flood waters of the River stand for?
questions.explanation: The Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory, which will overflow and sweep onward into Judah.

answers.text: The king of Syria and his horsemen
The king of Assyria and all his glory

questions.text: Who does this chapter say must be respected as holy, feared and dreaded?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread."

questions.text: What will Yahweh be for both houses of Israel?
questions.explanation: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall.

questions.text: What does the speaker say he and the children Yahweh has given him are for?
questions.explanation: He says, "Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel."

questions.text: Instead of consulting those who have familiar spirits and wizards, with whom should a people consult?
questions.explanation: The text asks, "shouldn't a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?"
